name: claude-context-extractor
description: Claude Code plugin for extracting As-Is business context from meeting transcripts and routing it to functional folders.

plugins.name: context-extractor
plugins.description: Extracts As-Is business context (processes, roles, systems, rules, problems, decisions, terms, open questions) from meeting transcripts, asks one batched clarification round, and routes results into configurable functional folders. Includes a glossary steward for canonical-name management with case-insensitive duplicate detection.
